title: Their Beloved Uncle Is A Parasite Part 1

series.summary: Rick discovers a fake uncle living with his family, executes the alien parasite on sight, and quarantines the home right as a new bizarre friend appears.

cuts.voiceover_text: The Smith family is having a cheerful breakfast with Uncle Steve, a beloved relative staying in their home. Beth checks her phone and discovers Steve secretly bought plane tickets to Paris for everyone. Jerry, Morty, and Summer erupt with joy, hugging him and celebrating the best uncle in the world. Rick suddenly walks in dragging trash filled with glowing radioactive rocks. But as the family celebrates, one terrifying truth hangs over the table: Uncle Steve does not actually exist.

Rick turns to insult Jerry, but freezes the moment he spots Steve sitting comfortably at the table. Steve smiles warmly, telling Jerry that any employer would be lucky to hire him. Rick glares with cold suspicion and bluntly asks who he is. Jerry insists Steve is his brother who has lived with them for nearly a year. Steve laughs, joking that Rick must be losing his mind. Rick does not hesitate. He draws his laser blaster and shoots Steve straight through the chest. Jerry and Beth scream in horror as Steve collapses backward onto the floor. But then the camera cuts to the body. Steve's human skin melts away, exposing a grotesque, tentacled purple alien parasite. Rick stands over the carcass, warning the stunned family that these telepathic parasites implant fake memories into minds to multiply and colonize worlds. Steve was never real, and their memories were completely fabricated.

To prevent a planetary outbreak, Rick slams the lockdown, dropping steel blast shields over every door and window. He orders everyone to watch for wacky new characters. Immediately, a little yellow creature named Mr. Poopybutthole cheerfully volunteers to help. Rick warmly thanks him. But with the house sealed, the horrifying question remains: is Mr. Poopybutthole real, or already an imposter?
